ra-tkua-sverige-juel-261583-vibe-1651-16.summary: Secret passages of Vibe's letters from Copenhagen, Bierreds and Flensborg, 1651 to May 1655: a seal of #876 to be copied from wax impressions; a servant debauched to get a packet of letters, and work to intercept letters of #872; #353 and #397 leaving for #770 with an instruction, and a border meeting (1653); Würtz said to be ennobled by #222; fireships built by #222; an opened letter of #879 (1654); a design that leaves the States General perplexed, and something to lie in the Sound (1655). The 49 code numbers that name the actors are not identified.
ra-tkua-sverige-juel-261583-vibe-1651-16.en:
Image 77, N. 316. To have the seal (signet) of #876 rightly engraved, #355 must press the ordinary seal of #876 in wax two or
three times, clearly; then another can be made exactly like the first, so that all stays unnoticed.

Images 78-79, N. 319. Some time ago #545 debauched the boy of #818, who took a big {packet} of letters; #818 wrested it from
him and carried it {away} {secretly}, although there was nothing in it that could be {prejudicial} to him. Perhaps there were some
of #873's and #479's letters. The impudent #485 took his leave with the valet of #254, to do his best to debauch my former
{servant} Charles, to see if he could procure some letters of #872. Quo poterant ibant, quo non poterant ibi stabant. Work is now
going on to intercept some letters of #872 of {importance}, for which the wedding, or the Diet (Herredag) <...>, will give an
occasion ...

system: Shift cipher with the shift chosen per word: each cipher word is an opener (1-3 or 24-39) giving a shift k (24-29 -> 0, 30-34 -> 1, 35-39 -> 2, 1-3 -> 3), then body numbers = rank of the letter + k in a 25-letter alphabet a...u w x y z ø, not cyclic; two- to…
